searchTerms.title: Products or services
searchTerms.description: What the suppliers make or do, e.g. office furniture, cnc machining, packaging, olive oil.

countries.title: Supplier countries
countries.description: Two-letter country codes, e.g. DE, IT, GB, FR, ES, PL, TR. Empty = all of Europe.

startUrls.title: Europages search URLs
startUrls.description: Optional: Europages search result pages to read as they are, e.g. https://www.europages.co.uk/companies/germany/packaging.html

includeDetails.title: Phone, VAT ID and employees
includeDetails.description: Open each company page for phone, fax, VAT ID, employee count, full address, product keywords, payment methods, payment terms and Incoterms. Off = search data only (name, website, city, country, type), faster.

requireWebsite.title: Only companies with a website
requireWebsite.description: Skip companies that list no website.

maxCompanies.title: Maximum companies
maxCompanies.description: Stop after this many companies in total.
